No switch, source change, or in-shot time transition accounts for the jump to daylight and back to night within an otherwise continuous night sequence.

findings.invariant_violated: temporal flow (single forward timeline per shot)
findings.description: In one continuous shot (1:51-1:58) the waitress exists as two simultaneous semi-transparent instances for about six seconds: one rises from the stool and walks behind the counter while another independently wipes the mid-counter. Motion branches into two concurrent timelines instead of one continuous forward flow; the superimposition persists far longer than a normal dissolve and the duplicated action has no cause within the scene.
